description: NGINX Ingress (OSS) overview built on nginx-prometheus-exporter stub_status metrics. Layout follows the Ingress Nginx / Overview mixin dashboard (16677).

panels.title: Dropped Conn/s
panels.description: accepted - handled. Anything above 0 means NGINX hit a resource limit (worker_connections / rlimit).

panels.title: Ingress Summary
panels.description: One row per ingress controller (namespace/job). Click a column header to sort.

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, job) (rate(nginx_ingress_nginx_connections_accepted{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) - sum by (namespace, job) (rate(nginx_ingress_nginx_connections_handled{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

100 * sum by (namespace, job) (nginx_ingress_nginx_connections_active{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}) / ($max_connections * count by (namespace, job) (nginx_ingress_nginx_up{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}))

panels.title: Dropped Conn/s by Ingress
panels.description: accepted - handled per ingress controller; should be 0

targets.expr: sum by (namespace, job) (rate(nginx_ingress_nginx_connections_accepted{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) - sum by (namespace, job) (rate(nginx_ingress_nginx_connections_handled{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Requests per Connection (keep-alive reuse)
panels.description: http requests/s divided by handled connections/s. ~1 means no keep-alive reuse.

panels.title: Peak Saturation (active / max connections)
panels.description: stub_status does not expose worker_connections, so saturation = active / $max_connections (dashboard variable).

panels.title: Dropped Connection % (accepted - handled) / accepted
panels.description: Percentage of accepted connections that were not handled

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (namespace, job) (nginx_ingress_nginx_connections_active{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}) / ($max_connections * count by (namespace, job) (nginx_ingress_nginx_up{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}))

100 * (sum by (namespace, job) (rate(nginx_ingress_nginx_connections_accepted{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) - sum by (namespace, job) (rate(nginx_ingress_nginx_connections_handled{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))) / clamp_min(sum by (namespace, job) (rate(nginx_ingress_nginx_connections_accepted{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])), 0.0001)

panels.title: Writing Share of Active Connections
panels.description: High writing share = slow clients or slow upstream responses

targets.expr: 100 * sum by (namespace, job) (nginx_ingress_nginx_connections_writing{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}) / clamp_min(sum by (namespace, job) (nginx_ingress_nginx_connections_active{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"$job",instance=~"$instance"}), 1)

panels.title: Scrape Success %
panels.description: share of exporter /metrics requests answered with HTTP 200 over the selected time range

panels.title: Prometheus Targets Up
panels.description: Prometheus' own `up` for the selected targets (works even if promhttp_* metrics are dropped)

panels.title: Scrape Duration
panels.description: Prometheus-side scrape duration of the exporter

panels.title: Scrape Requests Total by HTTP Status (req/s)
panels.description: Counter has a `code` label (200/500/503). Summed by code so it renders even with many instances.

title: F5 NGINX Ingress OSS / Overview
